description: A smaller footprint for quick runs and for images where content-provider writes are slow. Enough to clear a zero-row emptiness check without the cost of a full seed.
rationale: Most dormancy checks test for zero rows rather than for a realistic volume, so a light seed clears them at a fraction of the seeding time.
Use this when the run budget is short; use default_retail_user when the sample is known to profile the device in depth.
